findings: Self-hosted/colo network-segment command construction validates provider-neutral VPC create requests and rejects provider-VPC drift before emitting commands or receipts.
Targeted unit tests cover command shape, provider receipts, provider-VPC drift, invalid config, and absence of credential fields.
Site, cell, fabric, endpoint, command path, and evidence refs live in the self-hosted adapter crate; the domain owns only the provider-neutral VPC port contract.
Adapter command bodies contain references and tenant network metadata, not private keys, tokens, or live credentials.
ChangeSet is isolated to one new adapter crate, one additive provider kind, catalog/product/plan status, and evidence.
Avoids claiming IP-003 or FD-001 complete; CDN, remaining second-provider adapters, and credentialed live smoke remain pending.
Oya VCS claim/work accepted before writes; promotion remains through verify/done/promote.
FD-001 evidence, multispectrum evidence, and audit-chain row identify the same ChangeSet id.
Kept self-hosted/colo special cases in a single adapter crate instead of branching provider logic through domain/API code.
No cloud SDK, hypervisor SDK, or runtime network dependency was introduced in this request-contract slice.
The slice improves hyperscaler independence by proving a first-class on-prem/colo VPC target behind the same provider-neutral VPC port used by OCI VCN.

F3_adversarial.diagnostic_asserted: Provider VPC drift, invalid flow-log shape, invalid site/cell/fabric config, and credential leakage are rejected or absent before adapter receipts are emitted.
findings: Tests exercise provider-VPC drift rejection, VPC flow-log validation, invalid config, and absence of private_key/token in adapter command contracts.
Adapter constructor exposes narrow endpoint/site/cell/fabric configuration and returns inspectable command structs for handler integration and tests.
Deterministic self-hosted VPC command structs follow the existing OCI/S3 adapter lint/test pattern without adding dependencies.
Rejected adding live OVN/OVS/BGP clients in this ChangeSet; deterministic request contracts keep credentialed live smoke as a later bounded slice.
Rejected treating on-prem/colo as prose-only doctrine; added a first-class adapter crate and provider kind behind the existing port.
Request translation is deterministic string assembly with no network call or runtime SDK client.
Catalog, architecture-boundaries, data-class, planning, honest-claims, and targeted Rust gates passed for the self-hosted VPC adapter contract.
IP status intentionally says live-smoke and remaining second-provider network surfaces pending, preventing a false FD-001 production-readiness claim.

known_gaps.reason: This slice proves adapter port and provider command contracts without embedding self-hosted control-plane credentials or making network calls in CI.
CDN, remaining second-provider LB/DNS/interconnect adapters, and live provider smoke remain outside this rollback-safe VPC slice.
